Commercial Planters in Lindale, TX
item.description: Commercial planter services in Lindale Lindale has the kind of independent retail and hospitality that benefits most from good planters — a restaurant entrance with well-designed pots reads as “this place is cared for” before anyone opens the menu. We work with Lindale restaurants, retail storefronts, medical offices, and churches. What Lindale business owners ask for Business entrance planters and storefront pots Patio planters for restaurants and coffee shops Seasonal flower pots — rotated for spring, summer, fall, and holidays Holiday planters, including custom commercial holiday installs Easy to work with Because we’re based in Tyler and drive I-20 regularly, our schedule works cleanly for Lindale — installs happen on the same rotation as our Tyler commercial accounts.

item.title: Container Gardens in Bullard, TX
item.description: Why Bullard Bullard’s rural character and larger lots mean planters get seen from a distance — front-porch pots, gate-entry arrangements, and entertaining patios all benefit from a composition that reads at scale. We design for that. Past Bullard-area work A lot of our East-Texas-camp and retreat experience (including our work for Pine Cove) applies directly to properties around Bullard and Lake Palestine. We know how to scale planters for big porches, long walks, and outdoor dining areas.

item.title: Container Gardens in Tyler, TX
item.description: Planter services in Tyler, TX Tyler is our home market. Our studio is based here, and it’s where most of our container gardens, commercial planter installs, and seasonal rotations happen. We know which plant palettes actually hold up in a Tyler summer — and which ones look great on tour day but are crispy by August. Commercial clients in Tyler Over the years we’ve installed container programs at Christus Trinity Mother Frances Hospital, Pine Cove, and a rotating list of Tyler-area offices, country clubs, and medical facilities.

item.title: Planter Design & Installation in Tyler, TX
Planter Design in Whitehouse, TX
item.description: Whitehouse is close to home Whitehouse is one of the faster-growing communities around Tyler, and we regularly pick up work in and around the ISD area, along Highway 110, and in the newer residential developments. Because we’re already making the Tyler loop, Whitehouse seasonal rotations stay on the same schedule. Typical Whitehouse engagements Front-porch planter design for newer homes Storefront and small-business pots along Highway 110 Church and school-office entrance container gardens Seasonal color and holiday planters Work with a horticulturist Every Whitehouse planter we install is designed by a trained horticulturist — so the plant selection, sun exposure, and water needs are built for East Texas, not guessed at.

item.title: Planter Services in Flint, TX
item.description: Flint, TX is part of our regular route Flint sits just 10–15 minutes from our Tyler studio, and we service it on the same schedule as Tyler proper. That matters for seasonal rotations: when we’re turning Tyler planters from summer to fall, your Flint property is on the same rotation. Popular Flint projects Flint has a great mix of lakefront homes near Lake Palestine and growing commercial corridors. Most of our Flint engagements are residential container gardens — porch planters and patio pots for larger homes — plus the occasional local-business or church storefront install.
